question:
Re-generate 6 built Go files for smoke-2 defects (contract known, do not read contour.yaml): control/control.go (Status gains LimitsUnknown + LastExit *Exit, five_hour/seven_day marshal null while LimitsUnknown; Usage limits null while LimitsAt zero), supervisor/loop.go + supervisor/guard.go (Loop.Resumes renamed Restarts; Exited(code, stderr, now, cfg) counts every exit before phase_done/wait_operator, then a "crash" stop), daemon/daemon.go and daemon/pump.go (pass stderr to Exited, log the exit, no restart storm), cmd/morphd/main.go (newID returns a UUID v4).
Packages outside control, supervisor, daemon, cmd/morphd do not change. Out of scope: api, mcpserver, every other package.
Name every test and caller that relies on the old behaviour: Loop.Resumes, Exited(code, now, cfg) with no stderr, Status.FiveHour/SevenDay marshalled as 0, the 32-hex session id.

answer.reasoning: The six built files carry the API change: control.Status gains LimitsUnknown/LastExit and Usage must marshal limits null while LimitsAt is zero (control/control.go), supervisor.Loop.Resumes becomes Restarts with json "restarts" in loop.go/guard.go and Exited widens to (code, stderr, now, cfg) counting every exit before phase_done/wait_operator and then taking the crash stop, daemon/daemon.go and daemon/pump.go are its callers (pump passes the exit's stderr, logs the exit and must not restart storm, daemon.go supplies LimitsUnknown and LastExit for Status), and cmd/morphd/main.go's newID must return a UUID v4 instead of 32 hex chars. The tests pinning the old behaviour must be regenerated as well: supervisor/guard_examples_test.go reads l.Resumes and calls the 3-arg Exited, supervisor/loop_examples_test.go asserts the old "resumes" tag, daemon/daemon_examples_test.go and daemon/pump_examples_test.go use Exited(code, now, cfg) (pump_examples_test.go line 496 reads state.Loop.Resumes), control/control_examples_test.go builds Status/Usage expecting five_hour/seven_day as plain non-null ints with no LimitsUnknown/LastExit, and cmd/morphd/config_examples_test.go exercises the main.go newID/Config wiring that must now mint UUID v4. stream/parse.go is only read: it defines stream.Result/Limits that Exited and Limits consume and it does not change.
